issues.quote: Operating cash flow weakened more noticeably, falling to $89.8 billion in fiscal 2023 from $122.2 billion in fiscal 2022.
issues.problem: Apple's fiscal 2023 operating cash flow was about $110.5 billion, not $89.8 billion. Fiscal 2022 was $122.2 billion, so the real drop was about 9.5%, not the roughly 26.5% the stated figures imply.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate, with one error. Revenue ($383.3B vs $394.3B, -2.8%) is right. Net income ($97.0B vs $99.8B, -2.8%) is right. Total assets ($352.6B vs $352.8B), total liabilities ($290.4B vs $302.1B) and cash and cash equivalents ($30.0B vs $23.6B) are also right. The error is fiscal 2023 operating cash flow: it was about $110.5B, not $89.8B. That means the analysis overstates how much cash flow weakened.
